posted_materials.submission_timeframe_notes: "Catholic Health will accept applications any time during the collection process. The financial assistance eligibility is assessed as of the date the application was received."
posted_materials.other_materials_notes:
Plain language summary directly on website landing page. ASSETS (from policy): " Assets – Catholic Health does not consider a patient’s liquid assets when reviewing eligibility for 
financial assistance." However, does mention assets will be looked at for cases of medical indigence.

application.notes: Missing income tables (only have discount tables). Fully waives payment for those under 300% of the FPL. Income tables are in a separate document.

policy_summary.notes: Uses FPL % to determine assiatnce in PLS.

review_notes.other_notes: PSA -- "CH shall extend free or discounted care to eligible individuals, residing in the United States, for medically necessary services. The medical condition of the patient shall not be a factor in determining eligibility."
